input.content:
import duckdb

con = duckdb.connect()
P = "'./data/crashes.parquet'"

print("== null borough rate by year ==")
print(con.sql(f"""
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date)::INT y, COUNT(*) n,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN borough IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) null_pct
FROM {P} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"""))

print("== monthly Brooklyn crash counts (reporting discontinuities?) ==")
print(con.sql(f"""
SELECT STRFTIME(crash_date, '%Y-%m') m, COUNT(*) n, SUM(number_of_persons_injured) inj
FROM {P} WHERE borough='BROOKLYN' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"""))

print("== Brooklyn annual detail 2013-2025 ==")
print(con.sql(f"""
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date)::INT y,
 COUNT(*) crashes,
 SUM(number_of_persons_injured) all_inj,
 SUM(number_of_pedestrians_injured) ped_inj,
 SUM(number_of_pedestrians_killed) ped_killed,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(number_of_pedestrians_injured)/SUM(number_of_persons_injured),1) ped_share
FROM {P} WHERE borough='BROOKLYN' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2025
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"""))

print("== Brooklyn pedestrian injuries by month of year, 2013-2015 vs 2023-2025 ==")
print(con.sql(f"""
SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2015 THEN '2013-15'
            WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date) BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025 THEN '2023-25' END grp,
 COUNT(*) crashes, SUM(number_of_pedestrians_injured) ped_inj, SUM(number_of_pedestrians_killed) ped_killed
FROM {P} WHERE borough='BROOKLYN' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date) IN (2013,2014,2015,2023,2024,2025)
GROUP BY 1"""))

print("== top contributing factors in Brooklyn ped-injury crashes 2013-2025 ==")
print(con.sql(f"""
SELECT contributing_factor_vehicle_1 f, COUNT(*) n
FROM {P}
WHERE borough='BROOKLYN' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2025
  AND number_of_pedestrians_injured + number_of_pedestrians_killed > 0
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 12"""))

import duckdb

con = duckdb.connect()
P = "'./data/crashes.parquet'"

# Can we recover borough from zip_code for records with NULL borough?
print("== NULL borough records: how many have a usable zip? ==")
print(con.sql(f"""
SELECT COUNT(*) null_boro,
 SUM(CASE WHEN zip_code IS NOT NULL AND regexp_matches(zip_code, '^[0-9]{{5}}') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) has_zip,
 SUM(CASE WHEN zip_code LIKE '112%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) bk_zip,
 SUM(CASE WHEN latitude IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) has_lat
FROM {P} WHERE borough IS NULL"""))

print("== zip prefix distribution among NULL-borough rows ==")
print(con.sql(f"""
SELECT CASE WHEN zip_code IS NULL THEN 'NULL'
            WHEN regexp_matches(zip_code,'^[0-9]{{5}}') THEN SUBSTRING(zip_code,1,3) ELSE 'other' END pfx,
 COUNT(*) n FROM {P} WHERE borough IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 15"""))

print("== does zip agree with stated borough? (non-null borough) ==")
print(con.sql(f"""
SELECT borough, SUBSTRING(regexp_extract(zip_code,'^[0-9]{{5}}'),1,3) pfx, COUNT(*) n
FROM {P} WHERE borough IS NOT NULL AND regexp_matches(zip_code,'^[0-9]{{5}}')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY borough, n DESC"""))

# Recompute Brooklyn series with borough OR Brooklyn zip
print("== Brooklyn annual, stated-only vs stated+zip-recovered ==")
print(con.sql(f"""
WITH s AS (
 SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date)::INT y,
        SUM(number_of_pedestrians_injured) ped_inj,
        SUM(number_of_pedestrians_killed) ped_ked,
        COUNT(*) n
 FROM {P} WHERE borough='BROOKLYN' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2025
 GROUP BY 1),
r AS (
 SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date)::INT y,
        SUM(number_of_pedestrians_injured) ped_inj,
        SUM(number_of_pedestrians_killed) ped_ked,
        COUNT(*) n
 FROM {P} WHERE (borough='BROOKLYN' OR (borough IS NULL AND zip_code LIKE '112%'))
   AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2025
 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.y, s.n stated, r.n recov, s.ped_inj st_inj, r.ped_inj rc_inj,
       s.ped_ked st_ked, r.ped_ked rc_ked
FROM s JOIN r USING (y) ORDER BY s.y"""))

import duckdb

con = duckdb.connect()
P = "'./data/crashes.parquet'"

print("== citywide ped injuries/killed vs Brooklyn (borough-assigned rows) ==")
print(con.sql(f"""
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date)::INT y,
 SUM(number_of_pedestrians_injured) city_ped_inj,
 SUM(CASE WHEN borough='BROOKLYN' THEN number_of_pedestrians_injured ELSE 0 END) bk_ped_inj,
 SUM(number_of_pedestrians_killed) city_ped_ked,
 SUM(CASE WHEN borough='BROOKLYN' THEN number_of_pedestrians_killed ELSE 0 END) bk_ped_ked,
 SUM(CASE WHEN borough IS NOT NULL THEN number_of_pedestrians_injured ELSE 0 END) assigned_ped_inj
FROM {P} WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2025
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"""))

print("== rows w/ vs w/o borough: injury profile ==")
print(con.sql(f"""
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date)::INT y,
 SUM(CASE WHEN borough IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_missing,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN borough IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) miss_pct,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN borough IS NULL AND number_of_persons_injured>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       /NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN borough IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),1) miss_inj_pct,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN borough IS NOT NULL AND number_of_persons_injured>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       /NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN borough IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),1) pres_inj_pct
FROM {P} WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2025
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"""))

print("== crude bbox check: missing-borough rows with coords, rough Brooklyn box ==")
print(con.sql(f"""
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date)::INT y, COUNT(*) n,
 SUM(CASE WHEN latitude BETWEEN 40.55 AND 40.74 AND longitude BETWEEN -74.05 AND -73.83 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) in_bk_box
FROM {P}
WHERE borough IS NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2025
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"""))

import duckdb

con = duckdb.connect()
P = "'./data/crashes.parquet'"

print("== coord sanity for missing-borough rows ==")
print(con.sql(f"""
SELECT COUNT(*) n,
 SUM(CASE WHEN latitude IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_lat,
 SUM(CASE WHEN latitude=0 OR longitude=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zero,
 SUM(CASE WHEN latitude BETWEEN 40.4 AND 40.95 AND longitude BETWEEN -74.3 AND -73.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) in_nyc_box
FROM {P} WHERE borough IS NULL"""))

print("== grid classifier: mode borough per 0.01-deg cell (using records WITH borough) ==")
con.sql(f"""
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE cells AS
SELECT round(latitude::FLOAT, 2) la, round(longitude::FLOAT, 2) lo, borough, COUNT(*) n
FROM {P}
WHERE borough IS NOT NULL AND latitude BETWEEN 40.4 AND 40.95 AND longitude BETWEEN -74.3 AND -73.6
GROUP BY 1,2,3
""")
print(con.sql("""
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT format('{}_{}', la, lo)) cells FROM (
  SELECT la, lo, borough, n,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY la, lo ORDER BY n DESC) rn FROM cells) t WHERE rn=1"""))

print("== how well does nearest-cell mode classify held-out borough-present rows? (50% sample) ==")
con.sql(f"""
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE train AS
SELECT * FROM cells WHERE hash(la || lo || borough) % 2 = 0
""")
# mode borough per cell in train
print(con.sql("""
WITH cellmode AS (
  SELECT la, lo, arg_max(borough, n) b FROM train GROUP BY 1,2),
held AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT round(latitude::FLOAT,2) la, round(longitude::FLOAT,2) lo, borough
  FROM (SELECT * FROM cells WHERE hash(la || lo || borough) % 2 = 1)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.b IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) covered,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.b = h.borough THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) correct
FROM held h LEFT JOIN cellmode c USING (la, lo)"""))

con = duckdb.connect()
P = "'./data/crashes.parquet'"

# valid-coordinate, borough-present records
con.sql(f"""
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE geocoded AS
SELECT collision_id, round(latitude::FLOAT,2) la, round(longitude::FLOAT,2) lo, borough
FROM {P}
WHERE borough IS NOT NULL AND latitude BETWEEN 40.4 AND 40.95 AND longitude BETWEEN -74.3 AND -73.6
""")

con.sql("""
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE train AS
SELECT la, lo, borough, COUNT(*) n FROM geocoded
WHERE hash(collision_id) % 2 = 0 GROUP BY 1,2,3
""")
con.sql("""
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE cellmode AS
SELECT la, lo, arg_max(borough, n) b, SUM(n) cell_n FROM train GROUP BY 1,2
""")

print("== holdout accuracy of cell-mode classifier ==")
print(con.sql("""
SELECT COUNT(*) n,
 SUM(CASE WHEN c.b IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) covered,
 SUM(CASE WHEN c.b = g.borough THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) correct,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN c.b = g.borough THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) acc_pct,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN c.b IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) covered_pct
FROM geocoded g LEFT JOIN cellmode c USING (la,lo)
WHERE hash(collision_id) % 2 = 1"""))

# neighbor fill for uncovered cells: nearest cell within small radius
con.sql("""
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE nbr AS
SELECT c1.la, c1.lo, arg_max(c2.b, c2.cell_n) b
FROM cellmode c1 JOIN cellmode c2
  ON abs(c1.la-c2.la)<=0.03 AND abs(c1.lo-c2.lo)<=0.03
GROUP BY 1,2
""")
print("== holdout accuracy with neighbor fill ==")
print(con.sql("""
SELECT COUNT(*) n,
 SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.b, nb.b) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) covered,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.b, nb.b)=g.borough THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) acc_pct
FROM geocoded g
LEFT JOIN cellmode c USING (la,lo)
LEFT JOIN nbr nb USING (la,lo)
WHERE hash(collision_id) % 2 = 1"""))

# Now classify all missing-borough rows with coords
con.sql(f"""
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE missing AS
SELECT collision_id, round(latitude::FLOAT,2) la, round(longitude::FLOAT,2) lo
FROM {P}
WHERE borough IS NULL AND latitude BETWEEN 40.4 AND 40.95 AND longitude BETWEEN -74.3 AND -73.6
""")
print("== recovered borough mix among missing-borough rows (coords present) ==")
print(con.sql("""
SELECT COALESCE(c.b, nb.b, 'UNCLASSIFIED') b, COUNT(*) n
FROM missing m LEFT JOIN cellmode c USING (la,lo) LEFT JOIN nbr nb USING (la,lo)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC"""))
